console.name: timeline
console.title: Camel Timeline
console.description: Per second, what each route did, the errors, and the failed and slowest exchanges

exchanges.label: query
exchanges.description: Whether to include the kept exchanges

seconds.label: query
seconds.description: The number of seconds, up to the recorded seconds (the default)

end.description: Epoch second of the last second (the oldest is end - seconds + 1)

seconds.description: The number of seconds of each series, oldest first

exchangesDone.description: Exchanges done per second, in the routes they came in

from.description: The from endpoint URI (only present when known)

completed.description: Exchanges completed per second, not counting the recovered and handled ones

recovered.description: Exchanges per second that completed after a redelivery in this route

handled.description: Exchanges per second whose failure the error handler handled

inflight.description: Exchanges in flight at the end of each second

meanMillis.description: Mean processing time per second in milliseconds

p95Millis.description: p95 processing time per second in milliseconds, of the exchanges that came into this route

maxMillis.description: Max processing time per second in milliseconds, of the exchanges that came into this route

redeliveryAttempts.description: Redelivery attempts per second in this route

down.description: Per second 1 when a camel-chaos rule had the route down (stall or a lifecycle fault), else 0 (only present with camel-chaos)

routeId.description: The route ID where the exchange failed

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the exception (only present when known)

chaosRule.description: The camel-chaos rule that made the error (only present for a chaos fault)

errors.description: The errors by route and exception (only present when there are any)

id.description: The id of the camel-chaos rule

rule.description: The rule in its one-line text form

faults.description: The faults the rule fired per second

chaos.description: The faults per second of each camel-chaos rule that fired in the seconds (only present when one did)

routeId.description: The route ID the exchange came in

fromEndpointUri.description: The from endpoint URI (only present when known)

timestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the exchange was created

handled.description: Whether the error handler handled a failure of the exchange

exception.description: The exception message (only present when the exchange failed)

chaosRule.description: The camel-chaos rule that faulted the exchange (only present when one did)

elapsed.description: Elapsed time of the call in milliseconds

endpointSends.description: The remote endpoints the exchange was sent to (only present when any)

exchanges.description: Per second the failed and handled exchanges (up to 10) and the 3 slowest, oldest first (only present when asked for)
